item.title: Lanes reopened after dump truck hits overpass on I-75 in Sarasota
item.description: SARASOTA, Fla. (WFLA)— Two northbound lanes were closed on I-75 in Sarasota after a dump truck hit an overpass. All lanes reopened just before 4 p.m. Monday, according to an update from the Sarasota County Sheriff's Office. item.title: Bill that could halt plans for Manatee County cruise port heads to DeSantis' desk
item.description: A bill that could halt plans for a new cruise port in Manatee County is now on its way to the governor's desk.

item.title: Middle schoolers say they were inappropriately touched by Polk County substitute: PCSO
item.description: A 32-year-old man was arrested last week after being accused of inappropriately touching multiple students while working as a substitute teacher at two Polk County middle schools.

item.title: Florida woman accused of firing shots at Rihanna's Los Angeles home
item.description: The woman accused of firing several shots at singer Rihanna's home has been booked for attempted murder.

item.title: Mike Evans leaving Tampa Bay Buccaneers, expected to sign 3-year 49ers deal
item.description: Tampa Bay Buccaneers wide receiver Mike Evans is expected to leave Tampa for San Francisco, according to reports.

item.title: Florida woman 'knowingly' lets newborn drown in toilet after giving birth, sheriff says
item.description: A Palm Coast woman was arrested on March 6 after deputies say she allowed her newborn to drown in the toilet after "unexpectedly" giving birth at her home, the Flagler County Sheriff's Office said.

item.title: City shines blue to honor fallen Tampa officer who died in the line of duty
item.description: The City of Tampa will be illuminated in blue Monday evening in honor of a Master police officer who sacrificed his life in the line of duty five years ago.

item.title: Florida mother who let boyfriend beat her 5-year-old son gets 60 years in prison
item.description: A Florida mother who allowed her boyfriend to "repeatedly beat and torture" her 5-year-old son will spend the next 60 years in prison, the Volusia County Sheriff's Office said.

item.title: Man shot, killed after fight breaks out at Brandon apartment complex: deputies
item.description: A man was shot and killed Monday afternoon after deputies said a fight broke out at a Brandon apartment complex.

item.title: Gunman shot 2 people before shooting Pasco deputy, sheriff says
item.description: A Pasco County deputy and two civilians were shot by a gunman Thursday, according to Sheriff Chris Nocco.
